description: This file defines classes and types for managing timers within the ocudu namespace, including timer identifiers, states, durations, and the timer_manager and unique_timer classes for timer lifecycle management and callbacks.

classes.name: timer_detail::frontend_state
classes.description: Struct holding timer state information accessible from the front-end, including timer ID, current state, and duration.

classes.name: timer_manager
classes.description: Class managing creation, lifecycle, and ticking of timers, including handling timer states and callbacks.

classes.name: unique_timer
classes.description: Class representing an individual timer that can be configured, started, stopped, and queried for its state.

classes.name: timer_factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating timers associated with specific task executors.

methods.name: timer_manager::tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock by one tick and triggers expired timers.

methods.name: timer_manager::create_unique_timer
methods.description: Creates a new unique_timer instance associated with a given task_executor.

methods.name: timer_manager::nof_timers
methods.description: Returns the total number of timers managed.

methods.name: timer_manager::nof_running_timers
methods.description: Returns the number of timers currently running.

methods.name: unique_timer::set
methods.description: Configures the timer duration and optional callback for expiration.

methods.name: unique_timer::reset
methods.description: Cancels the timer and resets its state.
